issues.description: findChangedFiles result path format may not match isIncluded's cleanUrl(slash(filename)) comparison
issues.detail: In isIncluded, filename is normalized via cleanUrl+slash, then checked with this.changedFiles.includes(filename). VitestGit.findChangedFiles likely returns absolute paths in a specific format; if it doesn't match exactly (e.g., trailing query, different casing on Windows, or relative vs absolute), no files will ever be included, silently producing empty coverage.

issues.description: globCache.clear() in onTestRunStart races with concurrent isIncluded callers
issues.detail: onTestRunStart populates changedFiles and clears globCache, but isIncluded may already have cached entries computed before the changed filter was applied. If onTestRunStart runs after some transforms have already populated cache (e.g., v8 provider warmup), stale 'included=true' values from pre-filter computation could persist across runs in watch mode.

issues.description: CLI transform mishandles --coverage.changed=false case, inheritance still kicks in
issues.detail: resolveConfig sets coverage.changed from resolved.changed only when coverage.changed === undefined. But CLI users passing --coverage.changed=false get a literal false, which is correct. However, if a user omits --coverage.changed entirely while passing --changed, they always inherit — there's no documented way to opt out via CLI besides --coverage.changed=false, which isn't covered by a test.

issues.description: onTestRunStart is called after _testRun.start, potentially missing coverage for early file processing
issues.detail: In core.ts, onTestRunStart fires after _testRun.start(specs). If coverage instrumentation or file resolution happens during start(), changedFiles won't be set yet and isIncluded will return cached true values for non-changed files. The hook placement should probably precede _testRun.start or before any isIncluded call.

issues.description: CLI transform accepts boolean inputs that can't come from CLI parsing
issues.detail: The transform checks `value === true` and `value === false`, but CLI args are always strings. These branches are dead code in the CLI path. Harmless but misleading; either document why or remove.

issues.description: File mode change to 0755 on changed.test.ts is unintentional
issues.detail: The test file changed.test.ts had its mode bit flipped to executable (old mode 100644 → new mode 100755). Test files don't need executable permission; this looks like an accidental chmod from the contributor's environment and should be reverted.

review.summary: The PR adds a useful coverage.changed option with reasonable test coverage and docs. Main concerns are around path-normalization consistency between VitestGit output and isIncluded's cleanUrl/slash normalization, and the ordering/timing of onTestRunStart relative to _testRun.start which could let stale glob cache entries leak through. The CLI transform has dead branches and an accidental executable bit was set on a test file. Overall feature-complete but worth one more pass on path handling and hook timing before merge.
